operating_notes.text: Polycon Infra Projects Private Limited was incorporated on April 24, 2026 with authorised capital of ₹1.00 Cr and paid-up capital of ₹10 lakh, 100% held by Polycab.
FY26 FMEG segment swung to a ₹548.38 million profit from a ₹389.26 million loss in FY25.
FY26 EPC segment revenue fell to ₹16,664.96 million from ₹19,192.39 million, with segment profit down to ₹1,655.50 million from ₹1,806.40 million.
The company recognised a ₹196.22 million incremental gratuity and compensated-absence charge in the December 2025 quarter on the new Labour Codes.
FY26 international business contributed 5.4% of consolidated revenue.
Q4FY26 EPC EBIT margin was 7.6%; FY26 EPC EBIT margin was 9.9% on a 13% revenue decline.
Fans grew nearly 2x YoY in Q4FY26 and became the largest category within the FMEG portfolio.
Domestic wires and cable organized market share increased to 30-31% in FY26.
Bharat Net contract is ₹8,000 Cr overall with a ₹4,500 Cr execution piece over 3 years; supply portion is about 30% and fibre is already secured, so high fibre prices do not affect it.
RDSS order book was about ₹3,250 Cr when execution started; Bharat Net and RDSS together stand at ₹10,900 Cr, with about ₹800 Cr expected from RDSS this year.
Data centre cable demand is estimated at ₹3.5 Cr per MW, with 50-60% conventional and the rest optical fibre; the opportunity is ₹20,000-25,000 Cr over 6-8 years.
NCLAT stayed NCLT Ahmedabad order admitting Polycab into CIRP over a ₹2.79 Cr operational debt dispute by Asier Metals.
Q2FY27: FMEG EBIT margin expanded to 10.1% from 0.5% YoY.
H1FY27: Acceptances increased by ₹2,290 Cr, aiding working capital.
Q2FY27: FMEG EBIT margin 10.1%, first time in double digits, with solar inverters the largest category.
Q2FY27: EPC revenue ₹617.1 Cr (+53% YoY) at 7.2% EBIT margin; order book ₹9,000-10,000 Cr.
Q2FY27: Exports 5% of revenue, up 17% YoY and 85% QoQ, across 94 countries.

timeline.summary: On April 24, 2026, Polycab incorporated Polycon Infra Projects Private Limited as a 100% subsidiary with ₹10 lakh paid-up capital to undertake EPC projects.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹8,864.48 Cr (+26.9% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹772.77 Cr (+6.3% YoY).
Board of Directors, led by Vice President Legal and Company Secretary Manita Carmen A. Gonsalves, recommended ₹47 per equity share final dividend for FY 2025-26 on May 06, 2026.
Q4FY26/FY26 results (consolidated): FY26 revenue ₹28,884 Cr (+29% YoY), PAT ₹2,708 Cr (+32% YoY); Q4 revenue ₹8,864 Cr (+27%), PAT ₹786 Cr (+7%), EBITDA margin 13.1%.
Polycab India Limited hosted an earnings conference call on May 06, 2026, discussing Q4 FY2026 performance with Senior Management and analysts.
Polycab reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹8,864 Cr (+27% YoY) and proposed a final dividend of ₹47 per share.
Polycab India Limited’s shareholders re-appointed Ms. Sutapa Banerjee (DIN: 02844650) and Mr. Bhaskar Sharma (DIN: 02871367) as Independent Directors via postal ballot on May 10, 2026.
Polycab's Q1FY27 call (July 16, 2026) reported 39% YoY revenue growth, highest-ever quarterly PAT of ₹797 Cr, and FMEG EBIT of 8%, with the Bharat Net and RDSS order book at ₹10,900 Cr.
NCLAT stayed the NCLT Ahmedabad order initiating CIRP against Polycab India over an alleged operational debt of ₹2.79 crore.
NCLAT advanced the hearing date for Polycab's appeal against Asier Metals to October 15, 2026.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹9,898.9 Cr (+52.8% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹977.37 Cr (+42.6% YoY).
Polycab India Limited uploaded the audio recording of its earnings conference call held on October 15, 2026, to its website.
Polycab announced that NCLAT heard and reserved its order on the appeal in the matter of Asier Metals on October 15, 2026.
2026-10-19: Polycab filed the transcript of its October 15 Q2FY27 earnings call, where it held FY30 margin guidance and said the EHV plant would commission in FY28.
